# Max Boving

> Personal portfolio for Max Boving, an AI and data engineer working across data science, software engineering, and applied AI.

## About

Max builds practical systems from complex data and software problems, with experience across environmental research, legal education, business analytics, predictive modeling, RAG systems, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

## Selected work

- Projects: CEO intelligence assistant, environmental data and AI platform, autonomous agentic trading bot, and AI surf technique coach.
- Experience: AI customer support platform, jury simulation and trial intelligence, and data quality and governance platform.
